name: wordpress/gutenberg
description: Prototyping since 1440. Development hub for the editor focus in core.

ignore-id.PKSA-z3gr-8qht-p93v: CVE-2026-24765: unsafe deserialization in PHPUnit's PHPT-format code-coverage handling. This repository has no .phpt-format tests, and unit-test.yml's test-unit-php/test-unit-php-multisite commands never pass a --coverage-* flag, so the vulnerable code path is never reached. Ignored to allow a PHP-5.6/7.0-compatible phpunit/phpunit release to resolve.
ignore-id.PKSA-v5yj-8nmz-sk2q: CVE-2026-45304: YAML parser exponential memory allocation via recursive collection-alias expansion in symfony/yaml. Only reachable when parsing untrusted YAML input; the only symfony/yaml usage this dependency graph exercises (PHPUnit 5.7's TAP log formatter) only serializes local data and is never invoked in this repository's own PHPUnit runs (no --log-tap flag is ever used). Ignored to allow a PHP-5.6-compatible symfony/yaml release to resolve, as a transitive dependency of phpunit/phpunit ^5.7.
ignore-id.PKSA-ft77-7h5f-p3r6: CVE-2026-45305: ReDoS via catastrophic backtracking in symfony/yaml's parser cleanup regex. Same reachability analysis as PKSA-v5yj-8nmz-sk2q above: only exercised by YAML parsing of untrusted input, which this repository's PHPUnit-5.7-driven usage never performs.
ignore-id.PKSA-b14r-zh1d-vdrc: CVE-2026-45133: stack exhaustion via unbounded recursion in symfony/yaml's parser for deeply nested blocks, sequences, and mappings. Same reachability analysis as PKSA-v5yj-8nmz-sk2q above: only exercised by YAML parsing of untrusted input, which this repository's PHPUnit-5.7-driven usage never performs.
ignore-id.PKSA-xxgb-wq2d-7gpg: CVE-2013-1397: symfony/yaml's parser could be made to instantiate arbitrary PHP objects or enable PHP-tag parsing without the caller opting in. Only reachable when parsing untrusted YAML with object support enabled, which this repository's PHPUnit-5.7-driven usage never does.
